RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for  ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday,  the April 30, 2008/Vaisakha 10, 1930 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Commerce and Industry; Defence; Earth Sciences; Home
Affairs; Information and Broadcasting; Labour and
Employment; Rural Development; Science and
Technology; Textiles)
Total number of questions — 20
165
Extension of NREGS benefits to
farming community
*521. SHRI B.J. PANDA:
MS. MABEL REBELLO:
Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government proposes to
extend National Rural Employment
Guarantee Scheme (NREGS) benefits to
the farming community;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government proposes to
grant labour subsidy to the farmers to work
on their own fields to help control migration
from rural areas and to address their distress;
and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Management support to rural
development programmes
*522. DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has introduced
management support to rural development
programmes and strengthening of district
planning process from financial year
2007-08;
(b) whether the scheme primarily focuses
on training and skill development of rural
development functionaries and members of
Panchayati Raj Institutions in rural
development at Centre, State and district/
block level by providing financial support
to State Institutes of Rural Development
and Extension Training Centres;
(c) if so, whether Government proposes
to create awareness amongst targeted
groups of rural development programmes
and mobilize them towards participatory
development programme sensitizing
opinion making; and
(d) if so, the extent of this scheme’s
implementation and helpfulness?

166
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Designing of software by TCS on
NREG programme
*523. SHRI MATI VIPLOVE
THAKUR: Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a specially
designed software has been prepared by
Tata Consultancy Service Social Sector
team, which helps in tracking every detail
in NREGA Scheme;
(b) whether it is also a fact that this
software has been successfully used in
Andhra Pradesh to prevent misuse of funds
meant for implementation of NREGA
Scheme;
(c) if so, the details of the said software;
and
(d) what steps Government propose to
take to use this software in the entire
country?
Persons still detained under TADA
*524. SHRI SHAHID SIDDIQUI: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) how many persons are still detained
under TADA in the country;
(b) the break-up, State-wise and
religion-wise; and
(c) whether after repealing of TADA,
confinement under this law is legal?
Inspection report of Admiral Gorshkov
*525. SHRI  M.V . MYSURA REDDY:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the inspection of Admiral
Gorshkov which was to be completed by
March, 2008 is over;
(b) if so, the details of inspection report;
(c) whether it is a fact that Russia has
made it clear to the Ministry that cost
escalation of Admiral Gorshkov is a must;
and
(d) if so, what is the price escalation
Russia has proposed and to what extent
Government has agreed to give?
Findings in Tenkasi bomb blast case
*526. SHRIMATI BRINDA KARAT:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) the findings of the police
investigation in Tenkasi bomb blast case;
(b) its implications on the national
security; and
(c) whether it is a fact that similar blasts
were conducted in Nanded and parcel bombs
in Maharashtra?
Steps to increase strength of women
in army
†*527. MS. SUSHILA TIRIYA: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) the percentage of women in the army
at present;
(b) whether Government proposes to
increase the percentage of women in the
army; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Custodial deaths in the country
*528. SHRI THENNALA G.
BALAKRISHNA PILLAI: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state the total number of custodial deaths
occurred in various police stations in the
country during the last two years, State-
wise?

167
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
ILO report on unemployment forecast
*529. SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA: Will the Minister of LABOUR
AND EMPLOYMENT be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the International Labour
Organisation (ILO) in its recent report has
revealed that there will be unemployment
of estimated 5 million in 2008;
(b) if so, the likely unemployment in
India as per the said report;
(c) whether the unemployment rate in
the country is increasing alarmingly and
the steps taken by Government to provide
jobs have not proved effective; and
(d) if so, the strategies to be adopted to
face the challenges of unemployment in the
country?
Violence in Nandigram
*530. SHRIMATI HEMA MALINI:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is taking any
step or directing to concerned State
Government to combat the violence in
Nandigram;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the number of lives lost so far during
violence?
Supply of drinking water in rural
areas
*531. SHRI KANJIBHAI PA TEL: Will
the Minister of RURAL DEVELOP-
MENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether any proposal for drinking
water supply through Sustainable
Community-managed Drinking Water
Supply for Rural Areas of Backward Tribal
Districts was sent to the Central
Government; and
(b) if so, the present status of the
project?
Weather-proof clothes
†*532. SHRI SHREEGOPAL VYAS:
Will the Minister of TEXTILES be pleased
to state:
(a) whether weather-proof clothes are
being manufactured in the country;
(b) if so, in which States;
(c) whether kosha and silk are also being
used in Chhattisgarh; and
(d) the quantum of assistance Centre is
providing to that State?
Resentment among traders due to FDI
in retail sector
†*533. SHRI BALA V ANT ALIAS
BAL APTE:
SHRI SHREEGOPAL VYAS:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
there is strong resentment among the traders
with regard to entry of Foreign Direct
Investment (FDI) and corporate houses in
retail sector;
(b) whether small traders have registered
their protest with Government in this
regard;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) the reaction of Government in this
regard?

168
Database prepared by National Bomb
Centre of NSG
*534. SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI:
SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the National Bomb Centre
of National Security Guard prepared a
database on the basis of threat perception
to protect our key security installations
and economic hubs, with primary focus to
save lives;
(b) if so, whether security experts have
emphasized greater need of carrying out
periodic security audits of such places; and
(c) whether a system of intelligence
sharing of time and location of possible
attacks amongst countries which have
established anti-terrorist cells has been
evolved?
Value of textiles produced and
exported
*535. DR. V . MAITREYAN: Will the
Minister of TEXTILES be pleased to state:
(a) the total value of textiles produced
and exported out of the country during the
last five years, both in value and quantity;
(b) the steps being taken to increase the
production and exports of textiles;
(c) whether it is a fact that the industry
is suffering for want of incentives for
exports; and
(d) what special steps are being taken
to improve and modernize the industry for
its optimum growth?
Allotment of houses under IAY
†*536. MISS ANUSUIYA UIKEY: Will
the Minister of RURAL DEVELOP-
MENT be pleased to state:
(a) the basis on which funds are
distributed by Government for allotment
of houses under the Indira Awas Yojana
(IAY);
(b) whether the funds are being
provided to the States for allotment of
houses on the basis of norms laid down;
and
(c) the State-wise details of the amount
allocated during the last three years?
Compensation to displaced SC
agricultural labourers
*537. SHRI JESUDASU SEELAM:
Will the Minister of RURAL DEVELOP-
MENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is paying any
compensation to the displaced Scheduled
Caste agricultural labourers depending on
private land and community land for their
survival;
(b) if so, what is the rate of
compensation;
(c) what are the provisions available;
and
(d) how Government is monitoring the
same?
Funds to rehabilitate surrendered
militants
*538. SHRI MATILAL SARKAR: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of attacks perpetrated
by extremist groups during the years
2006-07 and 2007-08 in different States
and Union Territories;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

169
(b) the number of death-toll and injuries
in those attacks;
(c) how many militants have come over
to normal life in these years in different
States and Union Territories; and
(d) the fund provided by the Central
Government and the State Governments
to rehabilitate these surrendered militants?
Attractive pay and perks for armed
forces
*539. SHRI S. ANBALAGAN: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a large number
of personnel leave armed forces mainly due
to inadequate pay and perks; and
(b) if so, the details thereof and the steps
proposed to be taken by the Union
Government to offer a more attractive pay
and perks to armed forces personnel down
from the soldiers to senior officers level?
N
EW DELHI; V . K. AGNIHOTRI,
The 24th April, 2008 Secretary-General.
V aisakha 4, 1930 (Saka)
Implementation of flood management
plan by NDMA
*540. SHRIMATI SYEDA
ANW ARA TAIMUR:
SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the National Disaster
Management Authority (NDMA) is staffed
with professionally trained personnel to
ensure effective implementation of the
13-point plan for flood management; and
(b) whether there is provision for
periodic monitoring mechanism to check
the preparedness, prior identification of the
source of supply of equipment for prior
warning, actual handling of flood control
activities, relief measures and association
with the NGOs, at the nodal district
level?

I N D E X

Information and Broadcasting :—

Rural Development : 521, 522, 523, 531, 536, 537,
